name: grace-commons-harness
description: Reproducible dual checker harness for Grace Commons formal models (TLA+ via tla-checker WASM, Alloy via the alloy.dist jar under an npm-provisioned JRE 17).
comment-jre: The JRE 17 (javajre-linux-64) is installed to /tmp/javajre by bootstrap.sh, NOT here: unpacking it into the mounted repo FS drops libjli.so and the launcher fails (exit 127).
